description: k3_fast: factored K=3 cumulant propagation (ARC reference mlp_cumulant_propagation, MIT) in 498 flopscope calls, measurement shot
k3_fast_c: k3_fast plus old-source compression (age 4, rank 320), measurement shot
k3_fast_s: k3_fast with exact Strassen-Winograd products (depth 3), measurement shot
k3_fast_sc: k3_fast plus compression and Strassen-Winograd, measurement shot
k3_fast_sc2: k3_fast_sc with Strassen-Winograd depth 4 for push and T^T, depth 3 for batched products, shared work arena
k3_fast_aug_sc_2l: augmented K=3 cumulant propagation (ARC reference, MIT) with compression and Strassen-Winograd; two dense legs per source (idea credit: team 504aldo, forum post 18218 section 2.1)

k3_fast_aug_sc_2l_b: k3_fast_aug_sc_2l with kz 4, old-source compression at age 6 to rank 192, Strassen depths (5, 2); two dense legs per source (idea credit: team 504aldo, forum post 18218 section 2.1)
k3_fast_aug_sc_2l_b + learned per-layer mean correction (lc)
k3_fast_aug_sc_2l_b + lc + per-neuron K4 law (lc2k)
k3_fast_aug_sc_2l_b + lc + lc2k law, leaner plumbing (unstacked Strassen views), 3T^T depth 6 on layers 4-8, batched depth 4 (lc2k_rd)

k3_fast_aug_sc_2l_b_lc2k_rd + W-message GRU corrector (hidden 32, fitted offline on 400 public MLPs) in place of lc and the per-neuron K4 law, folder estimator with wmsg.npz (idea credit: mliston, Phase 1 write-up, discourse 18170)

exact-saving twin of shot 11 (k3_fast_aug_sc_2l_b_lc2k_rd_wm): same computation with fewer billed FLOPs (boxed L/R and matrices einsums, last-layer variance through the push, VEC from its 49 monomials); predictions equal to float32 rounding

saturation-restricted exact-saving variant of shot 11 (E3+E5): push columns of alive neurons, 3T^T rows alive (alpha > -2.5) and columns in the |alpha| < 3.5 band with the exact t3 diagonal, fixed p99 frames

shot 13 (ex35_satrole_f) with the same predictions bit for bit: the restriction's gathers and scatters write into dead fixed buffers (no per-layer allocation) and the slices step runs over the live source slots in two fixed chunks (8 + 7); lower C/B, more wall and memory margin

shot 14 (fbv8) with the same predictions bit for bit and about 1% fewer billed FLOPs: the Strassen-Winograd work frames are one recursive-layout array per side, so each level's Winograd sums write the children in place (no per-level quadrant copies, frame cuts or quadrant slices)

shot 15 (fbv8_rsw) with the covariance step folded into the push: on layers 1-10, T = C W rides the Strassen-Winograd push and S0 = W^T T is one more Strassen product instead of the 3 n^3 einsum (about 2.1% fewer billed FLOPs, S 0-23 MSE ratio 1.00047); the Strassen work arena, frames and views are made once in setup() and reused by every predict (same billed predict FLOPs, fewer client round trips)

shot 16 (_cf_sp) plus a dead-center restriction at theta 2.0 (birth-layer atoms of neurons with alpha < -2.0 dropped under fixed p99 frames), with the gather buffers allocated once in setup and reused; billed FLOPs x0.951, S 0-23 MSE ratio 1.00647

sb2 sat-bins + dc20x dead-center gather on the depth-6 d6p base (1b3d3c5d383d95c7). Gates 10-08 window 16:55-17:30: L3 (gc off, lag-5) PASS, life no-growth 1.0046, mem client 0.051 / PC 3.49 GB, residual max 0.0924, OpenBLAS ABBA worst ratio 1.2567 (projected 57.4 s). Mac bench mean adjusted 3.2931e-09 (0.957 of shot 17 bench).

r143 bcxa8tv slot-B upside build on shot 18 line: symmetric S0 half-block, Strassen C.W non-fold, setup views, Bini <3,2,2;10> eps 2^-8 on 3T^T and covariance-free pushes, depth-6 3T^T L1-14, batched depth-5 rebuild/P; Mac bench 0.9387 of shot 18; B margins wall 95 s residual 0.3 s
r143 bcn slot-A build: shot 18 predictions bit-identical, predict-time re-carve dropped, FLOPs -0.665%
R25 wcf: bcxa8tv + R24 weighted compression + star K31 fold into 3T^T (lane A); slot-B candidate; Mac bench mini 0-19 0.967x bcxa8tv
R25 M1: wcf + einsum split (lane C) + column cuts (lane B); measurement shot, slot-B candidacy pending life bisect; Mac bench mini 0-19 0.917x bcxa8tv
R25 gst: wcf + retrained GRU gA (S 0.988x shipped GRU) + lane B column cuts (bc3 form, no split); slot-B candidate; Mac bench mini 0-19 0.922x bcxa8tv

R25 opb30a20: v2a with 3T^T band and last-layer band 3.0, 3T^T rows alive 2.0 (FLOPs x0.955); S 0-47 0.960x v2a (48/48); OpenBLAS 58.85 s; L3 (a) waived (16,862 arrays, store 17,724)

R25 qA@a15: opb30a20 + corrector v4 qA (taps 0,1,2,4,5,6,7) + 3T^T rows alive 1.5; S 0-47 0.941x shot 29 (46/48); OpenBLAS 57.73 s; L3 (a) waived (17,427 arrays, store 18,364)
